verdicts.reason: Both break the original's main graphic device. The white bars are pushed out to the extreme top and bottom edges, far from the translucent panel, so they no longer cut into it, and the panel floats alone in the middle of an upscaled, soft-looking polygon background with large dead areas above and below. A is worse: its headline is undersized and its panel is narrow, which leaves the message weak on the tall canvas. B's wider panel and larger headline at least give it a clear focal point, but its panel margins are uneven (tight on the left, wider on the right).
